# Vitalii Popov — Full-Stack Engineer

> Personal portfolio, CV, and engineering case studies for Vitalii Popov — full-stack engineer specialising in distributed systems and AI. Based in Chemnitz, Germany. Open to Berlin and EU/UK/US/UAE roles.

## About

Vitalii Popov is a full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience building systems that create measurable business value across e-commerce, mobility, and AI domains.

**Current role:** Full-Stack Developer at Infineon Technologies AG (2024–present)
**Education:** M.Sc. Web Engineering, Chemnitz University of Technology (in progress); B.Sc. Applied Mathematics, NRU HSE Moscow

## Key Achievements

- Replaced a €480K/year commercial parking guidance vendor with an in-house system at Infineon (8,000 users, 3,000 MAU)
- Built warehouse search for 200M+ items in under 5 seconds at OZON Tech
- Delivered 13 startup projects at WeDo.agency
- Published technical articles with 5,000+ views

## Core Stack

Backend: Python, C#, Go, Node.js
Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub CI/CD
AI/ML: RAG pipelines, Qdrant, LangChain, Ollama, MCP, Hugging Face, Embedding models
Databases: PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse
